decision: Retain bundled semantic light v2. Artist sprites improve synthetic portal recognition and some real maps, but both trial checkpoints lose stone/Astral sources and miss the real validation portal at .35.

comparison.change: Add 128 synthetic training scenes containing complete artist sprites. Eight further generated seeds remain held out. All original 152 sample records and tensor hashes are unchanged.
comparison.unchanged: Initial weights, real crop pool, seed, crop size, batch allocation, optimizer, learning rate, schedule, architecture, selection and threshold. CutMix is disabled.
comparison.changed_sampling: The synthetic pool grows from 128 to 256 training scenes; its sampling stream and mixture change. The two real crops per batch keep their original pool and RNG.

pretraining_plan.change: Add 128 artist-sprite training scenes to the unchanged v4 dataset; keep 8 new generated seeds reserved for evaluation. CutMix is disabled.

plan.selection: Highest validation F0.5; earliest tie; fixed best evaluated on test after training.

pretraining_plan.limits: Puny object designs were previously observed and are shared with validation/test artwork. This adaptation tests other layouts/contexts, not new object designs or styles. Existing labels and splits are unchanged.

recipe.method: frozen segmentation with physical light centers

timing_note: Training includes validation and checkpoint writes; some CPU tests overlapped. No controlled training-speed or inference-speed claim.
selection: Highest validation F0.5 at .35, earliest tie. Step 900 wins; last step 4800 ties but remains a separate diagnostic. No test result selected a checkpoint.

generated_error_analysis.scope: Eight reserved generated seeds. Object rectangles locate unmatched predictions; a point on an emitter may be a duplicate or displaced center, not a nonexistent light.

validation_confidence_diagnostic.scope: Post-training validation-only diagnostic. The selected step 900 and operating score .35 stay fixed; no test images enter this sweep.

preflight_correction: The first specification included one blank blade cell. The nonempty-alpha check rejected it before output creation or training. Removed that cell; the rejected specification remains preserved locally.
new_annotation_issue: The existing temple record labels 30 flame fixtures but has no lava points or ignore mask. It incorrectly treats luminous lava as training background. Historical temple counts describe only that flame list; a later dataset revision must address area emitters. This trial and its historical labels were not retroactively changed.
limits: Agent-reviewed source semantics and construction labels are not independent human ground truth.
Puny sprite designs and all real evaluation layouts were previously observed. Their shared artwork makes this adaptation evidence, not an unseen-style benchmark.
Eight new generated seeds were first evaluated after training and selection, but use the same sprites and simple floor generator as training.
Ship and Astral reviews are partial; full-map precision is unknown.
Temple annotations omit lava despite a full review mask; flame-list results cannot establish complete emitter recognition.
Repeated use of five real validation maps and only one cool portal limits selection reliability.
Unmatched predictions on real emitters can be duplicates or displaced centers.
Live Foundry import, other GPUs/operating systems, and release packaging were not run for this data-generation change.
